title: G4 Delta Run
style: Phonk with Matrix-inspired cinematic action energy, 145 BPM, pounding 808s and heart-thumping bass drums, acid synth leads, siren SFX, tire-screech transitions, male rap verses with powerful melodic hooks, verse-to-chorus lift, ad-lib doubles, chopped delays on key words, green-code risers and reverse swells, dark and wide mix with a triumphant finish, rap, theme, strong, stylized, soundtrack, natural, world, steady
lyrics:
[Intro]
Job break got the code now run, run, run!
go go go!
Safe and sound
Sirens, agent chatter, 808,
Safe and Sound,
Unit 48 — all good

[Verse 1]
Acid adrenalin pumping
Heart bass drum stomping
Conductor Mind
Next move to find
Guard got up, spin and drop
Roll upside down without a frown
As that clown will take you down
Driver ready, hands steady
Mirror eyes, here’s my guys!
Zyn Maths Driver in the sim

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
Everyone makes it out
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
G4 delta track
We all come back

[Verse 2]
Watch out, Pig Truck!
Driver drifts then push
No bacon tonight
Pigs safe and sound
Big black hearse truck
Means only one thing
Rest in peace, no releases
Sirens blare, drive no care
Cops are here, pigs I care

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
Everyone makes it out
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
G4 delta track
We all come back

[Bridge]
Driver spins, no pig skin
Big black truck, driver takes the tyre out
Pigs freed, safe and sound
Cops on the back, driver stop!
The driver drifts, sneaky sneaky
Phonk 808 slides, Panthera pounce
Shades the move, pork little piggies almost got smacked
On the G4 delta Track

[Verse 3]
Bumble Bee bytes raining green code tonight
The maths is tight, paths flying in the night
Matrix Agents building, spawning in the sim
Zyn Maths Driver sees the code, does the maths again
Doing the maths on the G4 delta track
360 degrees of freedom, reverse the vector back
Reverse, reverse, reverse — bending simulation rules
3 mirrors showing every possible move
Maths Driver calculated every decimal degree
Eyes of the night, viral stunts breaking free
Panthera pounce timed to the millisecond
Job Break complete, the equation is excellent
Zyn Maths Driver has us, safe and sound

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
Everyone makes it out

G4 delta track
We all come back

[Outro]
Driver got us home
Safe and sound
